Het project maakt onderdeel uit van de KRW-maatregelen SGBP3 2023–2027 van waterschap AGV en draagt bij aan het behalen van de ecologische doelen voor gezond en schoon water. De Opdracht wordt uitgevoerd volgens een tweefasenaanpak, bestaande uit een Bouwteamfase en, na een positief besluit van Opdrachtgever, een Uitvoeringsfase. In de Bouwteamfase werken Opdrachtgever en Opdrachtnemer gezamenlijk de uitvoeringsstrategie en de daarvoor benodigde Bouwteamproducten uit. Van de marktpartij wordt daarbij een actieve, samenwerkingsgerichte en inhoudelijke inbreng verwacht vanuit praktische uitvoeringskennis en ervaring met visstandbeheer. De Opdracht wordt door middel van een Europese Openbare aanbestedingsprocedure in de markt gezet en zal worden gegund op basis van de Beste Prijs-Kwaliteitverhouding (BPKV), met de verhouding 20% (prijs) - 80% (kwaliteit). De kwalitatieve beoordeling bestaat uit twee gewogen Gunningscriteria: GC1 – Plan van Aanpak (50%) en GC2 – Voorstel Samenwerking (30%).

title: Norway – Research services – Operationalisation and measurement of the police ́s commitment to the stand-by area.
description: The aim of the assignment is to develop a research based framework for operationalisation and measuring the police ́s commitment to work within police stand-by. The framework shall identify and describe central dimensions by their commitment ability, as well as develop indicators that can be used to measure these in a systematic manner. Furthermore, the assignment shall identify relevant variables and data sources that can provide a basis for measuring the commitment ability and assess their suitability as regards reliability, validity, data quality and practical applicability. The research assignment shall contribute to a common and knowledge based understanding of what characterises the police ́s ability to focus on stand-by and how this can be measured and followed over time. The aim is to establish a professional basis that can be used for management, management, analysis, evaluation, prioritising and further development of the police ́s stand-by at local tactical level. Furthermore, it is a goal that the research shall contribute to increased knowledge on what factors affect the commitment ability, and make recommendations on how the commitment can be measured in a way that is both professionally robust and practically relevant for the police.

title: Norway – Subscription services – Digital access to newspapers
description: The Norwegian Parliament needs to enter into a contract with a tenderer who can offer digital access to news sources that are not covered by the Norwegian Parliament ́s existing contracts. Access shall be available via PCs, tablets and mobile telephones, and it shall include newspapers in PDF format or equivalent e-newspaper format. The agreement is expected to include approx. 200 newspapers, but the number of available publications can vary during the agreement period. All news sources shall be available through a combined platform that provides users with general and clear access to the content, with good search and navigation possibilities.

title: Finland – Refrigerating and freezing equipment – Laboratoriotason kylmälaitteet humaaninäytteiden, verituotteiden ja reagenssien säilytykseen
description: Hankinnan kohteena ovat Fimlab Laboratoriot Oy:n käyttöön tulevat laboratoriotason kylmälaitteet (Laitteet) humaaninäytteiden, verituotteiden ja reagenssien säilytykseen. Hankintaan sisältyy toimitus, asennus, käyttöönotto, tuki- ja huoltopalvelut sekä laitteisiin liittyvät tarvikkeet ja lisävarusteet tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä kuvatuin ehdoin. Laitteiden huolto- ja tukipalveluista tehdään erillinen sopimus. Hankinta on jaettu kuuteen osaan laitetyypittäin; laboratoriotason jääkaappi, laboratoriotason jääkaappi-pakastin, laboratoriotason pakastin, syväjääpakastin, verijääkaappi laboratoriokäyttöön ja verikeskustason plasmapakastimet. Kukin osa sisältää 1 - 4 osa-aluetta, jotka on muodostettu laitteen koon, ominaisuuden tai muun eriävän käyttötarkoituksen perusteella. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan kaksi eri kauppanimeä (laitemallia), edellyttäen että hyväksyttyjä tarjouksia on riittävästi. Tarjoaja voi jättää yhden tarjouksen. Osatarjoukset ovat sallittuja sekä osien että osa-alueiden välillä. Tarjoaja voi tarjota kuhunkin tarjoamaansa osa-alueeseen yhtä tai enintään kahta eri kauppanimeä (laitemallia) ns. rinnakkaistarjouksena. Hintaliitteellä on arvio laitteiden hankintamääristä sopimuskaudella. Hankittavia Laitteita on eri tyyppisiä ja niitä hankitaan Tilaajan tarpeen mukaan (uusiin tarpeisiin ja nykyisten laitteiden tilalle niiden poistuttua käytöstä) pääosin Tilaajan toiminta-alueen tuotantolaboratorioihin (Tampere, Hämeenlinna, Jyväskylä, Lahti, Vaasa) ja satunnaisesti suurimpiin näytteenottokeskuksiin. Hankittava laitemäärä on arvio eikä se sido Tilaajaa. Toteutuvat hankintamäärät voivat olla siis arvioitua suurempia tai pienempiä. Hankinnalla pyritään varmistamaan laadukkaiden, turvallisten ja toimintavarmojen kylmälaitteiden saatavuus Fimlabin eri yksiköiden tarpeisiin kilpailukykyisin ehdoin. Laitteita koskeva sopimuskausi on kaksi vuotta. Sopimusta on mahdollista jatkaa yhdellä kahden (2) vuoden pituisella optiokaudella. Tuki- ja huoltopalveluista tehdään erillinen neljän vuoden pituinen sopimus. Huoltosopimusta on mahdollista jatkaa neljän vuoden sopimuskauden jälkeen toistaiseksi voimassaolevana.

title: Denmark – Printing services – Produktion, distribution og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og det blå EU-sygesikringskort
description: Amgros I/S (Amgros) er et interessentskab med de fem regioner. Amgros gennemfører udbuddet som indkøbscentral, indgår kontrakten med den vindende tilbudsgiver og varetager den efterfølgende kontraktstyring. Regionerne og Udbetaling Danmark er aftagere under kontrakten og afholder betalingen for deres respektive aftag. Udbuddet vedrører en samlet løsning for produktion herunder indkøb og håndtering af materialer, trykning, pakning, frankering og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og EU-sygesikringskort. Kontrakten omfatter en implementeringsperiode bl.a. fastlæggelse af kortenes design, etablering af nødvendige IT-integrationer samt gennemførelse af relevante test og prøver. Fra driftsdagen d. 1. april 2027, skal leverandøren på baggrund af modtagne bestillinger producere, distribuere og levere kortene til modtageradresser i Danmark og resten af verden. På baggrund af det historiske forbrug forventes et årligt aftag på ca. 3 mio. kort. Det faktiske aftag kan variere og kan afvige fra det forventede årlig aftag med +/- 30 %.

title: Ireland – Hire of buses and coaches with driver – Provision of Bord Bia Executive Transportation Services for Inward Study Visits and Related Business Programmes for Bord Bia
description: Bord Bia, the Irish Food Board, invites tenders from suitably qualified economic operators for the Provision of Executive Transportation Services for inward study visits and related business programmes throughout Ireland. The contract will support safe, punctual, professional and flexible executive transport for Bord Bia Participants, including international buyers, media, chefs, influencers, trade contacts and accompanying Bord Bia personnel.

title: Finland – Medical equipments – Luuppilasit (kirurgiset erikoissilmälasit) ja luuppivalot
description: HUS-yhtymä pyytää tarjouksia luuppilaseista (kirurgisista erikoissilmälaseista) ja luuppivaloista. Luuppilasit ovat suurentavalla optiikalla varustettuja erikoissilmälaseja, joita käytetään tarkkuutta vaativaan lähityöskentelyyn. Kilpailutus sisältää luuppilaseihin kiinnitettävät ja luuppien yhteydessä käytettävät luuppivalot. Kilpailutus sisältää myös luuppilasien ja luuppivalojen hankintaan liittyvät palvelut. Kilpailutus ei sisällä otsavaloja. Käyttäjän yksilöllistä tarvetta vastaavia ja yksilöllisesti valmistettuja Galilean- ja Kepler tyyppisiä luuppilaseja hankitaan vuosittain arviolta noin 20 kpl ja luuppivaloja noin 10 kpl. Kyseessä on arvio, eikä Tilaaja sitoudu ilmoitettuihin hankintamääriin. Tuotteet ja palvelua koskevat vaatimukset on tarkemmin kuvattu jäljempänä tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin. Luuppilasit ja luuppivalot muodostavat toiminnallisen kokonaisuuden, minkä vuoksi osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Tarjouspyyntö on jaettu kahteen tuoteryhmään, joista tuoteryhmä 2 (optio) on vapaaehtoinen tarjota. Hankintapäätös tehdään tuoteryhmän 1 perusteella. Tuoteryhmän 2 tuotteet liitetään osaksi sopimusta, mikäli tarjoajan kanssa solmitaan vertailun perusteella sopimus tuoteryhmässä 1. Hankintalain 65 §:n mukaisesti hankintayksikkö on ennen hankintailmoituksen julkaisemista kuullut alalla toimivia yrityksiä. Hankinnasta on julkaistu tietopyyntö Hilma-palvelussa 3.4.2026, Hilma-numero 2026-045617. Lisäksi hankintayksikkö on kuullut tietopyynnön yhteydessä ilmoittautuneita markkinatoimijoita lisäkeskusteluissa sekä pyytämällä markkinatoimijoita kommentoimaan alustavaa luonnosta tarjouspyynnöstä. Tavoitteena on kilpailutuksen avulla saada valikoimiin turvalliset ja toimintavarmat tuotteet. Hankintayksikkö valitsee kuusi (6) toimittajaa sopimustoimittajaksi. Mikäli hyväksyttyjä tarjouksia ei saada edellä mainittua määrää, voi hankintayksikkö valita kaikki hyväksytyt tarjoukset. Hankintasopimus on voimassa määräaikaisena kaksi (2) vuotta, jonka jälkeen se jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimusten suunniteltu alkamisajankohta on 18.01.2027. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo (alv 0 %) on yhteensä noin 450 000 euroa. Kyse on arviosta, eikä hankintayksikkö sitoudu ilmoitettuihin euromääriin ja tarjouspyynnössä ilmoitettuihin, arvioituihin kulutusmääriin. Lopulliset tilausmäärät voivat olla ilmoitettua suurempia tai pienempiä. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat vaatimukset on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisesti tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyvät myös tarjottuihin tuotteisiin liittyvät lisävarusteet, jotka ilmoitetaan liitteeseen 2 "Lisätuotteita koskeva hinnasto", lisäarvopalvelut sekä huoltopalvelut ja viankorjaus. Hankinnan kohde ja sitä koskevat vaatimukset on kuvattu yksityiskohtaisesti tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä.

title: Finland – Health and social work services – Osallistumispyyntö: Kotiin vietävien palvelujen hankinta
description: Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue (myöhemmin myös Tilaaja) pyytää osallistumishakemuksia kotiin vietävien palvelujen hankintaa varten. Kyseessä on julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeuksista annetun lain 1397/2016 (hankintalain) liitteen E mukainen hankinta. Hankinta toteutetaan dynaamisena toimittajarekisterinä, joka tarkoittaa hankintayksikön itsensä suunnittelemaa, hankintalain periaatteiden mukaista menettelyä hankinnan kohteena olevien palveluiden hankkimiseen. Hankinnan kohteena on Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen omia kotiin vietäviä palveluja täydentävä ostopalvelu. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on osallistumispyynnön liitteellä 2 "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialue valitsee dynaamiseen toimittajarekisteriin kaikki Palveluntuottajat, jotka täyttävät tällä osallistumispyynnöllä ja tämän osallistumispyynnön liitteillä asetetut vaatimukset. Sopimuskausi on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva. Tällä osallistumispyynnöllä otsikoissa esiintyvä käsite "tarjouspyyntö" viittaa tähän osallistumispyyntöön. Tällä osallistumispyynnöllä otsikoissa esiintyvä käsite "tarjous" viittaa osallistumishakemukseen.

title: Finland – Medical equipments – Tehdaspuhtaat suojakäsineet
description: Tuomi Logistiikka Oy kilpailuttaa Tehdaspuhtaat suojakäsineet Sisä-Suomen yhteistyöalueen hyvinvointialueelle eli Etelä-Pohjanmaan, Kanta-Hämeen ja Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueille sekä Sydänsairaala Oy:lle, Tekonivelsairaala Coxa Oy:lle ja Fimlab Oy:lle. Hankinnan kohteeseen kuuluu tehdaspuhtaat suojakäsineet joita käytetään erilaisissa hoitotyön, laboratoriotyön, hammashoidon, sairaala-apteekin, siivoustyön ja elintarvikkeiden käsittelyn tehtävissä. Hankinta on jaettu 8 osa-alueeseen. Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen yhteen tai useampaan osa-alueeseen. Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit ilmenevät tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä. Osa-alueet: 1. Nitriilikäsine lyhytvartinen 2. Nitriilikäsine pitkävartinen 3. Nitriilikäsine lyhytvartinen alta otettava 4. Nitriilikäsine lyhytvartinen kiihdytinvapaa 5. Nitriilikäsine lyhytvartinen valkoinen 6. Nitriilikäsine lyhyt- ja pitkävartinen solunsalpaajien käsittelyn kestävä 7. Nitriilikäsine kemikaalien käsittelyyn pitkävartinen 8. Käsineteline säädettävä Sopimuskauden pituus on yksi (1) vuosi, jonka jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa varsinaisen sopimuskauden jälkeen toistaiseksi voimassaolevana. Myös toistaiseksi voimassa oleva sopimus tullaan kilpailuttamaan arviolta neljän-viiden vuoden kuluttua varsinaisen sopimuskauden alkamisesta. Sopimuksen arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.6.2027. Etelä-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue alkaa käyttää hankintasopimusta 18.3.2029. Tällä hankintasopimuksella hankintoja tekevät Tuomi Logistiikka Oy sekä Tavarantilaajat: Etelä-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue. Tilaaja voi tällä hankintasopimuksella tehdä tavarantilauksia itselleen ja hankintalain mukaisille sidosyksiköilleen. Tavarantilaajat voivat tällä hankintasopimuksella tehdä Tavarantilauksia itselleen sekä tytäryhteisöilleen. Hankinnan arvioitu kokonaisarvo neljälle (4) vuodelle on noin 12 000 000 euroa, joka jakautuu alueittain seuraavasti: Pirkanmaa 60-70 %, Etelä-Pohjanmaa 20-30 % ja Kanta-Häme 10-20 %. Arvio sopimuskauden hankintamäärästä ei sido tilaajaa ja tilausmäärät voivat vaihdella vuosittain. Hankinnan vuosikulutusarviota on kuvattu tarjouspyynnöllä. Vuosikulutusarviossa on Etelä-Pohjanmaan kulutukset laskettu mukaan. Tähän hankintaan sovelletaan Euroopan parlamentin ja neuvoston asetusta (EU) 2022/1031 sekä komission täytäntöönpanoasetusta (EU) 2025/1197. Hankintayksikkö sulkee tarjouskilpailusta tarjoajat, joiden alkuperä on Kiinan kansantasavalta asetuksissa tarkoitetulla tavalla. Lisäksi tarjoaja sitoutuu siihen, että IPI-toimenpiteen kohteena olevasta kolmannesta maasta peräisin olevien tavaroiden tai palvelujen osuus ei ylitä 50 prosenttia sopimuksen kokonaisarvosta. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus pyytää tarjoajaa esittämään riittävä selvitys tarjoajan, alihankkijoiden sekä tarjottujen tavaroiden ja palvelujen alkuperästä.

title: Norway – Underground work other than tunnels, shafts and subways – Touched race Smååsane-Støleheia - Boretrasé
description: Vennesla municipality hereby invites tenderers to a competition for a drilling route - Drilling in rock and uncompacted matter for water and sewage pipelines. The background for the procurement is the order requirement in the development plan for connecting to public water and sewage installations before permits for use. In order to fulfil the requirement, water supply shall be established from Smååsane to Støleheia. The project includes a plumbing slide, rock drilling, erection of a elevated basin, two pressure boosters and a sewage pump station. This competition is for the drilling route in the project. This contract is for Contract 2 - Boretrasé. The contract includes drilling through clocks and rock (approx. 815 m) and drilling under roads (approx. 18m) for conveying water and sewage.

The purpose of release of these draft documents is to facilitate industry�s improved understanding of the Government requirements. title: PR16354857 - Limited Competition Justification and Award Notice Outbound Shipments
description: The purpose of this notice is to comply with posting requirement, FAR Part 5 and Subpart 6.301. Competition was restricted to a limited number of vendors capable of meeting current operational requirements, including the ability to ship via alternative routes. This restriction is necessary due to constraints imposed by ongoing regional instability, which has rendered standard shipping routes unreliable or unavailable. Limiting competition to qualified vendors ensures continuity of outbound shipping services under current conditions. The security situation in the region remains fluid and subject to sudden escalation. Recurring, rapid changes in regional security conditions are affecting carrier availability, shipping routes, transit times, insurance requirements, and overall logistics reliability with little advance notice. Shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz and other regional transportation corridors is unreliable and dangerous, with a result of limited bookings available from limited shippers In accordance with FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(ii), simplified acquisition procedures, quotations were solicited from three vendors determined capable of meeting the Government�s requirements under current operational conditions. Three quotations were received and evaluated based on technical capability, compliance with the required scope of services, demonstrated ability to meet urgent logistical and delivery requirements, relevant past performance, and price reasonableness. The selected contractor was determined to represent the lowest-priced technically acceptable quotation $33,248 USD and demonstrated the capability to successfully perform the required services within the required timeframe and operational constraints. The contractor also demonstrated a strong record of relevant past performance supporting U.S. Embassy Kuwait requirements, including reliable and quality performance under similar operational conditions. Award to this contractor will support Shipping in maintaining uninterrupted mission operations and accomplishing mission requirements

title: Common Armament Tester for Fighter (CAT-F)
description: This Synopsis serves as a notice of intent that the Automated Test System Contracting Branch, AFLCMC/ROKB, at Robins Air Force Base, GA, anticipates issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) on SAM.gov under Notice ID FA8533-25-R-0002 for the Common Armament Tester-Fighters (CAT-F). This effort requires the design, development, manufacture, and sustainment of the CAT-F for the F-16, F-15, and A-10 platforms, capable of testing Preload, Clean Wing, and Fault Isolation Requirements at both O-Level and I-Level Maintenance. The North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS) for this requirement is 334515, Instrument Manufacturing for Measuring and Testing Electricity and Electrical Signals, with a corresponding small business size standard of 750 employees, and Product or Service Code (PSC) 4920. This acquisition will be a Full and Open Competitive Acquisition with no small business set aside. This acquisition will utilize the Tradeoff Source Selection Procedures in accordance with the DoD Source Selection Procedures, dated 20 Aug 2022, and DAFFARS MP 5315.3. It will be comprised of an Initial Source Selection that will result in up to two (2) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts to two (2) offerors with a Final Downselect to at least one (1) contractor following Critical Design Review (CDR). The Initial Source Selection will result in the award for CAT-F System Design. In the Initial Source Selection, the Government will conduct a full and open competition to narrow the competitive field down to no more than two (2) contractors that will execute CAT-F System Design and proceed to the Final Downselect. The Contracts will contain options for the execution of the program beyond the basic contract. The Final Downselect source selection will determine which contractor�s Option I may be exercised. The IDIQ contracts will utilize a mix of pricing arrangements, including Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF), Firm Fixed Price (FFP), and Cost Reimbursement-No Fee (CR-NF). The Period of Performance for the resultant contracts shall include a 1 year Basic and 4 one year Options (in accordance with FAR 52.217-9, Option to Extend the Term of the Contract). The Basic is for Prototype Design and Digital Development of the O-Level and I-Level Testers. Option I is for EMD and Production but will only be exercised for the contractor(s) chosen during the Downselect. The following approximate quantities will be required for delivery during the Basic: Qty of 4 for the F-16 O-Level Handheld Tester Prototype Qty of 4 for the F-15 O-Level Handheld Tester Prototype Qty of 4 for the A-10 O-Level Handheld Tester Prototype The following approximate quantities will be required for delivery during Options I-IV: Qty of 303 EA for the F-16 O-Level Testers Qty of 172 EA for the F-15 O-Level Testers Qty of 68 EA for the A-10 O-Level Testers Qty of 143 EA for the F-16 I-Level Testers Qty of 80 EA for the F-15 I-Level Testers Qty of 42 EA for the A-10 I-Level Testers Delivery Schedule: O-Level Handheld Tester Prototypes will be delivered to begin 12 months ARO Order The approximate Request for Proposal (RFP) issue date is FY25 Q3, with a response date of 45 days later. In accordance with FAR 5.2079(c)(16)(i) All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. Foreign Participation is not permitted. title: Notification of Availability of Software Framework, Warped Alloy, for Software Defined Radio (SDR) Signal Chain
description: The Department of the Army is pleased to announce the availability of a cutting-edge software framework designed to enhance the capabilities of Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems. This framework enables the SDR signal chain to dynamically adjust its capabilities based on the sensed RF environment and to respond at the protocol level in real-time. The Department of the Army is releasing this software framework to foster collaboration with industry partners and encourage the integration of this technology into their SDR products. The intent is to enable greater flexibility in conducting radio frequency operations, allowing industry partners to leverage this framework to enhance their SDR systems' adaptability and operational effectiveness. By providing this framework, we aim to advance the state of SDR technology and promote innovation in the field of radio frequency operations. Key Features of the Framework: Rapid Reconfiguration: The framework allows for swift reconfiguration of the RF signal processing chain modules within the SDR�s field programmable gate array (FPGA), ensuring adaptability to varying operational requirements. FPGA-Based Physical Layer (PHY) and Media Access Control (MAC): The framework enables the rapid development and implementation of a fully-customized PHY and MAC layer that supports various signals and waveforms, providing a comprehensive solution for SDR applications. Elements Available for Industry: FPGA Top-Level Framework: This top-level hardware description language (HDL) framework resides within the SDR FPGA, facilitating seamless communication between the General-Purpose Processor (GPP) and the signal modules. Application Programming Interface (API): A user-friendly, common C-based API is provided, allowing developers to create SDR-agnostic applications that can manipulate the programmed signal FPGA modules effectively. Transport Interface (TI): The TI consists of dynamic or static C libraries utilized during application builds, enabling efficient message transport to and from user-based applications and FPGA signal modules. Exemplar Data Generation/Consumption Module: This module serves as a testing tool for hardware-specific implementations of the framework, ensuring compatibility and performance validation. Documentation: Comprehensive documentation will be made available, including development environment guides and a developer's guide, to assist industry partners in effectively utilizing the framework. The Department of the Army encourages industry partners to engage with this innovative framework, which is expected to significantly advance the capabilities of SDR technology. The Government retains all rights of modifications made to the original framework. To access this software interested parties shall complete the attached Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) (Attachment 1). Individuals identified as contractor representatives/users pursuant to signed/complete NDAs may then create an account on Test Resource Management Center (TRMC) to access the codebase. A step-by-step guide for creating a TRMC account and accessing the repository is included in Attachment 2. INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING THE NDA: An authorized representative of each contractor organization is to complete the following steps to ensure the NDA is processed correctly: Complete all fields on page 1. Complete and sign as the "Recipient�s Authorized Representative" on page 4. Complete the fields for the "Requesting Organization Authorized POC" on page 5. Sign the acknowledgement on page 5 and identify all contractor users from the company they represent. Obtain signatures from all authorized users identified on page 5. Return the completed NDA to the Warped Alloy Management Team at usarmy.meade.7-sig-cmd.mbx.warped-alloy-software@army.mil for final completion and signature of fields on page 6. For additional information or questions, please reach out using the contact information below. For inquiries, please send an email to the Warped Alloy Management Team at usarmy.meade.7-sig-cmd.mbx.warped-alloy-software@army.mil Thank you for your attention to this exciting opportunity.

description: UPDATE: 11/06/2026 The Government received noteworthy interest in one-on-one meetings. Describe the termination of coverage process and the expected burden on the beneficiary. Claims and Payments How are claim payments determined and processed, including if lump sum payments are one-time or recurring, and any applicable limitations? Would payments be taxable as income? How would beneficiaries submit claims/receive payments, and what is the expected burden on the beneficiary? Would there be any third-party liability? If so, please explain. description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (Bureau) is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes located within the city limits of the following cities within San Bernardino County, CA: San Bernardino, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga, Bloomington, Colton, Grand Terrace, Highland, Loma Linda, and Redlands and Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC Facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work entitled, "Residential Reentry Center, March 2022 SOW�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, Programs, of the aforementioned SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity type contract with firm fixed unit prices for all line items. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a maximum of 70 beds in which 56 beds will be designated for males and 14 beds designated for females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a maximum of 40 placements to include both males and females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. The Home Confinement Radius must be within 100 miles of the RRC facility. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. 15BRRC27R00000009 will be available on or about November 10, 2026, and it will be distributed solely through the Government Point of Entry website at www.sam.gov. title: PILOT PROGRAM TO ASSIST CERTAIN MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES AND DEPENDENTS WITH ADDITIONAL SUPPLEMENTAL COVERAGE RELATING TO CANCER HT9402-26-RFI-0255
description: UPDATE: 10/21/2026 The Government received several questions in the RFI submissions. The attachment labeled �RFI QA Responses HT940226RFI0255 Supplemental Pilot" is intended to address these questions. The DHA plans to continue gathering market intelligence by meeting with interested vendors. Vendor�s will be expected to address questions regarding their RFI submissions as well as general market intelligence needed by the Government and will be given the opportunity to ask the Government questions. Virtual meetings are anticipated to be held on 19 November 2026. Please email Mr. James Goddard to request a one-on-one meeting. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The Defense Health Agency (DHA) is currently in the planning phase for partnering with carriers of supplemental insurance focused on cancer coverage. This Request for Information (RFI) is intended to initiate market research efforts as the Government considers structuring processes to meet Congress� intent. Section 734 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year (FY) 2026 (Enclosure 1) requires DHA to establish a pilot program not later than September 30, 2027, under which members of the regular component of the Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force, or Space Force and their dependents enrolled in TRICARE may obtain supplemental cancer insurance for noncovered expenses under a fixed indemnity supplemental benefit. The supplemental coverage is intended to provide financial assistance for noncovered expenses related to cancer screening, diagnosis and treatment that are not otherwise covered by the health care benefits the individuals receive under chapter 55 of title 10, United States Code, or any other benefit provided by the Secretary of Defense. https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ60/PLAW-119publ60.pdf RFI Instructions: Prepare and submit a written response addressing each of the questions below. This response shall not exceed 20 pages in length and should not be solely your company�s general capability statement but instead specifically address the Government�s topics listed in this RFI. Please send your responses to the Defense Health Agency, Managed Care Contracting Division james.goddard22.ctr@health.mil by Close of Business 18 September 2026. RFI Questions: Plan Types and Coverage Scope Describe how a TRICARE specific plan would differ from current commercially available plans. What non-covered services under TRICARE would be covered? Would there be portability options if a beneficiary is no longer eligible for TRICARE? How could your company intend to add value to TRICARE beneficiaries? Describe an applicable case scenario. Coverage Details and Exclusions Detail general coverages provided in similar plans. Would there be any key coverage exclusions and limitations, including but not limited to: Acts of War, specific cancer types, pregnancy, and state-based restrictions? What annual or lifetime maximums on benefits would apply, and what conditions or treatments would be subject to caps or exceptions? What coverage would be provided for non-FDA approved drugs, participation in clinical trials, or other emerging and unproven treatments? Would pre-existing conditions be covered? If yes, what conditions would be included? Would there be any coverage limitations for a recurring diagnosis (remission or new)? In which states does your company offer coverage, and are there any state specific exceptions or restrictions that would apply to a TRICARE specific plan? How would this impact our mobile beneficiary population? Do your company�s plans provide coverage for beneficiaries residing or receiving care overseas? Eligibility and Enrollment Per the NDAA, the Government will not be subsidizing this pilot. To be financially viable, is there a minimum required enrollment threshold for such an unsubsidized, �no cost,� 100% beneficiary paid, group plan to be offered by your company? Is there a preferred eligibility verification process? What would prevent a member from being eligible? Describe the enrollment process and the expected burden on the beneficiary. When would coverage be effective? Any limitations? How would beneficiaries make premium payments? How are premiums structured today (in similar policies)? How would your company structure TRICARE premiums based on pilot requirements? Would premium rates be locked in for the duration of the pilot? Describe the termination of coverage process and the expected burden on the beneficiary. Claims and Payments How are claim payments determined and processed, including if lump sum payments are one-time or recurring, and any applicable limitations? Would payments be taxable as income? How would beneficiaries submit claims/receive payments, and what is the expected burden on the beneficiary? Would there be any third-party liability? If so, please explain. Describe the claims submissions and processing experience, including the average processing time and the availability of digital tools (such as online portals or mobile apps) for beneficiaries to submit and track claims. Reporting and Oversight What beneficiary data would your company provide to the Government/employer (e.g. cost, number of enrollees, denials, customer satisfaction, use case data)? Are there any limitations to data your company would be willing to share? Does your company recommend any specific data metrics DHA should track to accurately report the program�s success, beneficiary satisfaction, and programmatic feasibility to Congress? What board or organization oversees the supplemental insurance industry? Give some examples of standards, grievances, or reporting at a state or federal level. Qualifications How many years of experience does your company have providing supplemental insurance plans? What is your company�s claims acceptance/denial rate? What are the top 10 reasons for denials? How will your company protect beneficiaries� personally identifiable information? Acquisition Strategy What are ways to participate via �no-cost� or similar means? Does your company anticipate any barriers to participating in the pilot based on �no-cost� contract terms? The Government may publish future RFIs or hold an industry day. Communication for both will be made under the same announcement as the RFI. The Government appreciates the time and expense related to this posting. title: Switzerland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Verkehrszukunft Region Thun, Arbeitspaket 3: stadträumliche, verkehrliche, bautechnische und umweltplanerische Machbarkeitsstudie von zwei Tunnelvarianten
description: Arbeitspaket 3: Vertiefte städtebauliche bzw. stadträumliche, siedlungsräumliche, verkehrliche, bautechnische und umweltplanerische Machbarkeitsstudie für die beiden Tunnellösungen «Hübelitunnel» und «Aarequerung Süd» (Generalplaner) Das Projekt «Verkehrszukunft Region Thun» baut auf der Verkehrsstudie Thun Innenstadt – rechte Seeseite auf, die im Auftrag des Entwicklungsraums Thun bis Ende 2023 erarbeitet wurde. Untersucht wurden drei Varianten zur langfristigen Verbesserung der Verkehrssituation: der Hübelitunnel, die Aarequerung Süd sowie eine Gesamtverkehrsvariante mit Verkehrssteuerungen und Ausbauten für ÖV und Veloverkehr. Alle Varianten gelten grundsätzlich als machbar; die Gesamtverkehrsvariante wurde jedoch als kostengünstigste und wirksamste Lösung bewertet. Für den Fall, dass diese nicht ausreicht, sollen die beiden Tunnelvarianten vertieft geprüft werden. Der Bund betonte in Gesprächen zur möglichen Mitfinanzierung, dass ein Tunnelprojekt nicht isoliert betrachtet werden darf, sondern in ein überzeugendes Gesamtkonzept eingebettet sein muss. Zentral sind die Abstimmung von Siedlungs- und Verkehrsentwicklung, die Wirkung auf Stadtentwicklung und Arbeitsplätze, die Einbettung ins Gesamtverkehrssystem sowie flankierende Massnahmen. Die Nutzen der Varianten sind nachvollziehbar anhand der Kriterien der Agglomerationsprogramme darzustellen. Zudem braucht es einen klar begründeten Variantenentscheid, der zeigt, dass andere Optionen ausgeschöpft wurden und die gewählte Lösung breit akzeptiert ist. Die Region folgt dieser Empfehlung und vertieft die beiden Varianten Hübelitunnel und Aarequerung Süd parallel. Ziel ist ein politisch konsolidierter Entscheid bis Ende 2028 sowie die fachliche Einbettung in das Agglomerationsprogramm 6. Generation Thun. Dabei sollen die Anliegen von Bevölkerung, Politik und Verwaltung der betroffenen Gemeinden berücksichtigt und die Varianten anhand transparenter qualitativer und quantitativer Kriterien bewertet werden. Alternative Entlastungsvarianten sind nicht Gegenstand des Projekts; die bestehenden Tunnelvarianten können jedoch optimiert oder bei schwerwiegenden No-Gos ausgeschlossen werden. Neben der fachlichen Bewertung soll das Projekt einen öffentlichen Diskurs über Chancen, Risiken, Nutzen und Kosten einer Tunnellösung ermöglichen. Dabei geht es nicht um eine pauschale Tunnel-ja-oder-nein-Debatte, sondern um eine differenzierte Auseinandersetzung mit verkehrlichen, städtebaulichen, finanziellen und gesellschaftlichen Auswirkungen. Die Auftraggeberschaft liegt beim Entwicklungsraum Thun (ERT). Die strategische Führung übernimmt die Projektsteuerung durch den Ausschuss «Verkehrszukunft». Sie entscheidet über Zwischenergebnisse, Vergaben und Vorgaben. Die operative Projektleitung führt das Projekt. Ergänzend wirken politische, fachliche und öffentliche Begleitstellen mit. Die politische Begleitung reflektiert Zwischenstände aus politischer Sicht, die fachliche Begleitung sichert die Koordination mit parallelen Projekten und fachlichen Anforderungen, und die öffentliche Begleitung ermöglicht insbesondere Betroffenen in Thun und Steffisburg, Anliegen einzubringen. Die BHU bzw. Auftragnehmenden aus AP1 unterstützen fachlich, organisatorisch und in der Qualitätssicherung. Die externen Auftragnehmenden der Arbeitspakete AP1 bis AP4 erbringen Leistungen, haben aber keine Entscheidungskompetenz. Die Kernschritte AP4a (Zielsystem, Methodik), AP3 und AP4c (Variantenbeurteilung und Empfehlung) laufen grundsätzlich nacheinander. Für beide Tunnelvarianten wird mindestens ein inhaltlicher Planungsstand angestrebt, welcher unter dem Begriff «Machbarkeitsstudie» subsummiert wird. Hinsichtlich Planungstiefe bewegen sich die Leistungen im Bereich der SIA-Phase 2 Vorstudie. Für einzelne Aspekte (z.B. description: L'EPFL a l'intention d'acquérir un analyseur de sorption gravimétrique de gaz et de vapeur à haute pression pour son Laboratoire de Séparations Avancées (LAS) de la Faculté des Sciences de Base (FSB). L'équipement sera dédié à des recherches de pointe sur le comportement de sorption statique et dynamique de l'ammoniac (NH₃), de l'hydrogène (H₂), du dioxyde de carbone (CO₂), de l'azote (N₂) et de la vapeur d'eau sur des matériaux poreux et non poreux. Il doit être capable de fonctionner en mode statique (équilibre en système fermé, monocomposant) et en mode dynamique (flux continu multicomposant), y compris sous flux gazeux humidifiés et à des températures d'échantillon allant du sub-ambiant à l'élevé. Il doit être capable de tester des mélanges (NH₃/H₂), (CO₂/N₂/vapeur d'eau), etc.

title: Czechia – Servers – HW infrastruktura pro databázové služby a upgrade / konverze licenčních oprávnění Microsoft SQL Server
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je dodávka HW infrastruktury a souvisejících softwarových licencí a licenčních služeb pro provoz platformy pro kritické databázové služby na bázi Microsoft SQL Server, včetně souvisejících implementačních, konfiguračních a integračních činností v rozsahu stanoveném zadávacími podmínkami. Veřejná zakázka je rozdělena na části ve smyslu § 35 ZZVZ. Veřejná zakázka je rozdělena na následující části: Část 1 – Servery a příslušenství Předmětem plnění části 1 veřejné zakázky je dodávka serverové infrastruktury a souvisejícího příslušenství včetně základní konfigurace, podpory a záruky. Předmětem této části veřejné zakázky je zejména: • dodávka 4 ks serverů včetně veškerého příslušenství a komponent nezbytných pro jejich řádný provoz, • doprava dodávané infrastruktury, • základní konfigurace a integrace do stávající infrastruktury zadavatele, • zajištění kompatibility s používanou virtualizační platformou, • zajištění požadované vysoké dostupnosti a redundance, • dodávka a aktivace požadovaných softwarových licencí včetně příslušných licenčních oprávnění, • poskytování servisní podpory dodané infrastruktury po dobu 60 měsíců, • zajištění záručního servisu a dlouhodobé servisovatelnosti dodané infrastruktury, • předání technické a licenční dokumentace. Konkrétní technické a funkční požadavky na servery, jejich konfiguraci, příslušenství, softwarové licence, kompatibilitu a související služby jsou stanoveny v Příloze č. 3 této ZD – Minimální technické požadavky na dodávané řešení. Další informace o předmětu plnění a podmínkách plnění jsou uvedeny v Příloze č. 1 této ZD – Závazný vzor Smlouvy Část 1. Část 2 – Upgrade a konverze licenčních oprávnění Microsoft SQL Server Předmětem plnění části 2 veřejné zakázky je upgrade / Step-Up a konverze stávajících licenčních oprávnění Microsoft SQL Server Standard Core na licenční oprávnění Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise Core, včetně: • ověření stávajících licenčních oprávnění a možnosti provedení Step-Up, • provedení konverze licenčních oprávnění, • zajištění příslušného Software Assurance, • registrace a evidence licencí v příslušném licenčním systému společnosti Microsoft, • předání licenční dokumentace, • poskytnutí součinnosti zadavateli při řešení licenčních otázek souvisejících s předmětem plnění. Dodavatel je povinen zajistit úplné a řádné plnění předmětu této části veřejné zakázky v rozsahu nezbytném k dosažení požadovaného výsledku. Konkrétní požadavky na množství a parametry licenčních oprávnění určených ke konverzi jsou uvedeny v Příloze č. 1 smlouvy – Specifikace stávajících licencí určených ke konverzi.

title: Belgium – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – 6.25.1.9 Mission d’auteur de projet pour la restauration des façades du Musée Art et Histoire dans le Parc du Cinquantenaire à Bruxelles – Marché de services - Procédure ouverte
description: Le présent marché porte sur l’étude de la restauration des façades du Musée Art et Histoire sur le site du Cinquantenaire à Bruxelles. La Régie des Bâtiments a déjà rénové les autres façades du site. Dès lors, l’étude en vue de la restauration des façades extérieures et des façades des cours intérieures du Musée Art et Histoire du Cinquantenaire est opportune pour la cohérence de l’ensemble. Ces façades sont classées, voir Arrêté de classement du 22.04.2004 en annexe 04. Le marché vise les études complètes en vue de - la restauration des façades du Musée Art et d’Histoire (voir périmètre en annexe), y compris les statues, les lettrages, etc. - la faisabilité de la mise aux normes incendie en façade des bâtiments et d’un chemin d’évacuation supplémentaire au rez-de-chaussée pour l’Horeca actuel - la restauration de l’hémicycle du Musée Art et Histoire - étudier et proposer des possibilités d’intégration et/ou de reconversion de l’ancienne entrée de l’esplanade du Musée Art & Histoire, en vue de renforcer sa visibilité et d’en faire un véritable espace de mise en valeur des activités et collections du Musée. Pour plus d'information voir le cahier spécial des charges en annexe à cet avis de marché.

Okres gwarancji producenta stanowi jedno z kryteriów oceny ofert. Szczegóły dotyczące gwarancji zawarte są w § 7 projektu umowy – załączniku nr 5 do SWZ. 6. W opisie przedmiotu zamówienia, stanowiącym załącznik nr 6 do SWZ, Zamawiający opisał wymagania dotyczące parametrów i właściwości technicznych oferowanego sprzętu przez odniesienie do norm wskazanych w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia. W każdym przypadku, w którym normy te zostały wskazane w treści SWZ, w tym w załącznikach do SWZ, należy rozumieć, że wskazaniu takiemu towarzyszą wyrazy „lub równoważne”. Tym samym Zamawiający dopuszcza rozwiązania równoważne względem norm wskazanych w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia, zgodnie z art. 101 ust. 4 i 5 Pzp. Pod pojęciem równoważności rozumieć należy, że oferowany sprzęt w równoważnym stopniu spełnia wymagania określone w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia. Zastosowane rozwiązania równoważne muszą odpowiadać swoim rodzajem i zakresem celom, którym służą normy przywołane w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia. 7. Z uwagi na fakt dopuszczenia możliwości różnych propozycji równoważnych wymaga się od Wykonawcy weryfikacji i traktowania wszystkich rozwiązań jako powiązanych ze sobą. Wykazanie równoważności, tj. spełnienie w równoważnym stopniu wymagań określonych przez Zamawiającego w opisie przedmiotu zamówienia, leży po stronie Wykonawcy. W przypadku zaoferowania sprzętu spełniającego wymagania normy równoważnej lub innego rozwiązania równoważnego względem norm wskazanych w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia, Wykonawca zobowiązany jest wskazać to rozwiązanie w pkt 5 formularza ofertowego, stanowiącego załącznik nr 1 do SWZ, przedstawić informacje o zaoferowanym rozwiązaniu równoważnym, uzasadnienie jego równoważności oraz dowody potwierdzające równoważność. Zamawiający nie odrzuci oferty Wykonawcy tylko dlatego, że oferowany sprzęt nie spełnia wymagań norm wskazanych w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia, pod warunkiem, że Wykonawca udowodni w ofercie, w szczególności za pomocą przedmiotowych środków dowodowych, o których mowa w art. 104-107 Pzp, że proponowane rozwiązania w równoważnym stopniu spełniają wymagania określone przez Zamawiającego w pkt 1 oraz pkt 2 opisu przedmiotu zamówienia (art. 101 ust. 5 Pzp).

La actuación prevista tiene como finalidad garantizar una práctica deportiva segura, accesible y de calidad, mediante la sustitución integral del césped artificial, adecuando las instalaciones a los estándares técnicos y normativos exigidos por las federaciones deportivas correspondientes.

title: Germany – Construction work for steel bridges – Neubau HIPSII.2
description: Das neue Gebäude entsteht auf dem Campus der Universität des Saarlandes in Saarbrücken und wird durch das Helmholtz-Institut genutzt. Es handelt sich um einen Erweiterungsbau für den ersten Bauabschnitt des Helmholtz-Instituts für Pharmazeutische Forschung Saarland (HIPS) und ergänzt diesen funktional wie architektonisch. Der Erweiterungsbau ist östlich des Bestandsgebäudes geplant und mit dem Bestand durch zwei Brücken verbunden, die je den Büro- und Laborflur mit dem des Neubaus verbinden. Ergänzt wird der Erweiterungsbau durch östlich gelegene im Gelände eingebundene terassierte Parkflächen. Die Längsachsen des Gebäudes orientieren sich in ihrer Lage am Bestand. Das Laborachsraster wurde etwas weiter als im Bestand gewählt um letztlich eine flexiblere Geräteaufstellung zu erlauben. Dadurch entsteht für die Büros und Labore ein einheitliches, auf einem 1,2m Grundmaß basierendes Raster, das zur Vereinfachung der Konstruktion beiträgt. Der Neubau ist als viergeschossiges Gebäude mit einem zusätzlichen Staffelgeschoss und einer Gesamthöhe von ca. 22 m geplant. Das Baufeld liegt in Hanglage. Es ist im Erdgeschoss ebenerdig vom Garten aus zugänglich. Der Hauptzugang erfolgt im ersten Obergeschoss vom Straßenniveau aus. Das Gebäude besteht aus einem in den Hang gesetztes Erdgeschoss sowie 4 Obergeschossen, wobei das 4. OG als Staffelgeschoss ausgebildet ist. In diesem befindet sich hälftig die Technikzentrale sowie einem großen Sozialraum inkl. Dachterrasse. Außenabmessungen: ca. 66,00 x 33,00 m Die terrassierte Parkflächen bestehen im wesentlichen aus drei versetzten Parkebenen, welche über eine seitlich gelegene Zufahrt erschlossen werden (Ebene 1: 3 St Behindertenparkplätze / Ebene 2: 24 St Parkplätze / Ebene 3: 12 St Parkplätze). Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind die Rohbauarbeiten für den Neubau des Forschungs- und Laborgebäudes. Der Leistungsumfang umfasst die Baustelleneinrichtung, Erd-, Gründungs-, Stahlbeton-, Mauerwerks-, Abdichtungs- und Dämmarbeiten einschließlich der erforderlichen Entwässerungs- und Einbauteile im Rohbau. Weiterhin beinhaltet die Leistung die Herstellung der wasserundurchlässigen Baukonstruktion (Weiße Wanne), Fertigteil- und Verbundbauteile sowie alle zugehörigen Schutz-, Sicherungs- und Nebenleistungen. Verlegung Ring,- und Fundamenterder inkl. Betoneinbauten. Ausbau Grundleitungen in und unter der Bodenplatte. Ausbau von Gebäude Einführungen der TGA-Gewerke. ***Auftrag steht in Verbindung mit einem Vorhaben und/oder Programm, das aus Mitteln des Europäischen Fonds für Regionale Entwicklung (EFRE) finanziert wird.***

title: Norway – Occupational clothing – Framework agreement for workwear for health and education.
description: The Contracting Authority Innherred Anskaffelser KO (previously Innherred Innkjøp) was established 01.01.2019 and is a municipal assignment partnership between 11 municipalities. The objective of the cooperation is to implement rational, reliable and efficient procurements on behalf of the municipalities. The contracting authority ́s gender neutral preferred is: Julie Sandnes Any questions shall be sent to the gender neutral preferred via the tender management tool. There shall be no contact/communication with other persons at the contracting authority regarding the tender competition than the mentioned gender neutral preferred. The objective of the procurement The framework agreement is for the delivery of work clothing, outdoor clothing, work shoes, other work related footwear and the accompanying products to employees in the health, care and education sector in the participating municipalities. The objective of the framework agreement is to ensure access to functional, robust and seasonal clothing and footwear that supports employees ́ everyday work throughout the entire year. At the same time, the agreement shall contribute to simpler orders, better management of assortment and more equal treatment across municipalities and entities. The assortment shall cover work throughout the year and during varying weather, temperature and working conditions. This includes i.a. products for employees in nurseries, schools, before-and-after-school care, home care services, institutions, environmental services and other relevant municipal entities. These user groups have other needs than the technical sector regarding function, fit, assortment and ordering form. It is therefore chosen to carry out a separate procurement for this area. The agreement includes product deliveries, ordering system, customer service, size guidance, trial scheme, delivery, return, claims, product data, reporting and other services that are necessary for effective use of the contract. Tenderers ought to be aware that the procurement shall cover several municipalities and different service areas, and therefore there is a need for a system that functions both for continuous orders and for users who need testing and guidance when choosing a size and fit. The agreement shall be signed with one tenderer who shall be completely responsible for the entire delivery. The tenderer can use sub-suppliers and collaboration partners, but shall be fully responsible to the contracting authority for: All products that are delivered The ordering system Product Information Agreed prices and discounts Delivery and transport Customer Service Testing and size guidance Return, exchange and claims Reporting Contract follow-up Environmental obligations Follow-up of the supplier chain The municipalities in the contract have different local special agreements and there will be variations in which products each municipality will procure for its employees. The needs in the assortment can change if the municipalities ́ local special agreements are changed. The scope and value of the procurement The contract value is estimated to approx. NOK 8,620,000 excluding VAT per annum, giving an estimated total contract value of approx. NOK 34,480,000 excluding VAT for the entire duration of the framework agreement. The estimate is based on obtained information on the number of employees within relevant service areas in the participating municipalities, as well as a calculated annual average value of NOK 2,000 excluding VAT per employee. The amount is used as a technical calculation basis for estimating the contract value. The actual amount can vary considerably between the municipalities and between different service areas, i.a. due to the content of local special agreements, different needs for work clothes and different budgetary priorities. Several of the municipalities are, however, in the process of preparing or revising local special agreements for workwear, and there is, therefore, considerable uncertainty connected to both the number of users in the contract and the expected call-offs. The maximum contract value is NOK 40,000,000 excluding VAT. Please note that the stated value is an estimate and does not involve any purchasing obligations for the contracting authority or rights for the tenderer. The actual extent can be both higher and lower than the estimated within the contract ́s maximum value. Number of employees per municipality in health and education. Levanger municipality: 1000 Verdal municipality: 500 Inderøy municipality: 150 Steinkjer municipality: 850 Snåsa municipality: 150 Namsos municipality: 1000 Grong municipality: 280 Høylandet municipality: 175 (option) Lierne municipality: 95 Røyrvik municipality: 50 Flatanger municipality: 60 (option)

title: Norway – Interpretation services – Framework agreement for interpretation services
description: Background Innherred Anskaffelser KO is a municipal working partnership between 11 municipalities in Innherred and Namdalen in Trøndelag. The aim is to implement rational, reliable and efficient procurements on behalf of the participating municipalities. Inderøy municipality is the office municipality and a formal employer for employees in the cooperation. The framework agreement shall, upon the start of the agreement, include nine municipalities: Levanger, Verdal, Inderøy, Steinkjer, Snåsa, Grong, Lierne, Røyrvik and Høylandet. Namsos, Flatanger and Trøndelag county shall have an option to join the contract after the existing agreements expire. Municipal companies (KF) under the participating municipalities shall also be able to use the contract. The procurement shall ensure continued access to interpretation services after the current framework agreement expires and combine the municipalities into one joint contract. This shall contribute to better coordination, like practice, more general follow-up as well as a better basis for management, statistics and quality follow-up across the cooperation. Current situation, contract extent and option participants There is currently a framework agreement for interpretation services for Snåsa, Steinkjer, Inderøy, Verdal and Levanger. The agreement expires 30.11.2026. In 2025, a total of 9,247 interpretation assignments were registered for these municipalities, of which 9,168 are telephone interpretation, 67 video interpretation and 12 attendance interpretations. The statistics form the basis for estimating the extent in the new contract. Since the current contract was established in 2022, six municipalities in Namdalen have become a part of Innherred Anskaffelser KO: Grong, Lierne, Røyrvik, Høylandet, Namsos and Flatanger. The contracting authority does not have equivalent detailed statistics for these six municipalities. Based on the available ratio, the need is estimated to approx. 3,000 interpretation assignments per annum. The distribution between telephony, video and turn-out interpretation is mainly expected to be comparable to the historical distribution in the Innherred municipalities. The estimate is uncertain and is not binding for future withdrawals. Grong, Lierne, Røyrvik and Høylandet are included in the new framework agreement from the start of the agreement. Namsos and Flatanger have a separate framework agreement for interpretation services until 20.08.2027, and shall therefore have an option to join the new contract after this expires. Trøndelag county shall also have an option to join the framework agreement. The county ́s contract will run until 30.04.2027, and commencement can take place from 01.05.2027. In 2025 3,157 interpretation assignments were registered for Trøndelag county, of which 2,473 are telephone interpretation, 127 video interpretation and 557 attendances. Most of the attendance assignments were connected to Sør-Trøndelag, and it is anticipated that a significant amount will apply to the Trondheim area. Attendance assignments can also occur at the county ́s entities elsewhere in Trøndelag. At the turn-out interpretation, the tenderer must reckon on assignments in Innherred, Namdalen, the Trondheim area and other parts of Trøndelag, depending on the contract participants ́needs. Historical figures and geographical distributions are only a guideline and are not a guarantee for future volume or location. The estimated value of the framework agreement, based on available statistics and calculated ratios, is NOK 35,000,000 excluding VAT. The maximum value of the framework agreement is NOK 45,000,000 excluding VAT. Description of the assignment The procurement is for a joint framework agreement for the provision of interpretation services for the participants of the agreement. The agreement shall cover continuous need for telephony interpretation, video interpretation, ongoing interpretation of meetings and written translations, both planned and acute assignments. A large number of the assignments are expected to include telephone and video interpretation. The services will be used in ordinary municipal and county services, including health and care services, child protection, NAV, refugee service, adult education, schools, nurseries and other public service areas. The need will vary as regards language, scope, date, geographical location and which interpreter form is best suited. Tenderers shall have sufficient capacity and language coverage to handle a broad and varied need, also at short notice. The contract shall serve many orderers across municipalities, entities and service areas, and therefore there are high requirements for delivery ability, accessibility, quality and efficient systems for ordering and following up. The delivery shall always be in accordance with the Interpretation Act and associated regulations. The contracting authority places great emphasis on the use of qualified interpreters and that the best qualified interpreters available for each assignment are offered, based on the qualification categories in the National Interpreter Register. The framework agreement shall contribute to predictable and efficient access to high quality interpretation services, as well as facilitate uniform ordering routines, good follow-up and a better overview of the use of the services across the contract participants.

description: Predmet nabave je Opskrba električnom energijom za potrebe Općine Župa dubrovačka u 2027. godini, temeljem iskazanih potreba korisnika, sukladno tehničkim karakteristikama i ostalim traženim uvjetima naznačenima u Dokumentaciji o nabavi (u daljnjem tekstu: Dokumentacija). Isporučena električna energija mora sadržavati minimalno 50% električne energije iz obnovljivih izvora.Predmet ovog postupka javne nabave je opskrba električnom energijom za potrebe Općine Župa dubrovačka prema uvjetima iz ove dokumentacije o nabavi te ukoliko s ovima nisu u suprotnosti, prema reguliranim uvjetima na tržištu električne energije u RH - Zakona o tržištu električne energije (Narodne novine, br. 111/21, 83/23, 17/25), Pravilnik o općim uvjetima za korištenje mreže i opskrbu električnom energijom (Narodne novine, br. 100/22), Mrežnim pravilima distribucijskog sustava (Narodne novine, broj 74/18), Mrežnim pravilima prijenosnog sustava (Narodne novine, br. 10/24), Zakona o energiji (Narodne novine, br.120/12, 14/14, 102/15 i 68/18), Pravilima organiziranja tržišta električne energije (Narodne novine, br. 107/19), Pravila o promjeni opskrbljivača i agregatora (Narodne novine, br. 84/22, te ostalih propisa koji reguliraju tržište električne energije u RH. Radi stimuliranja proizvodnje energije iz obnovljivih izvora, a kako bi ona postala konkurentnija energiji dobivenoj iz konvencionalnih izvora, te poticanja izgradnje novih izvora obnovljive energije i postizanja održivog razvoja, naručitelj je odredio da električna energija mora sadržavati gore navedeni minimalni postotak električne energije iz obnovljivih izvora. Kao potvrdu ispunjenja uvjeta o podrijetlu električne energije, odabrani ponuditelj (Opskrbljivač) je obvezan po izvršenoj isporuci električne energije dostaviti Naručitelju važeću potvrdu iz Registra jamstava podrijetla električne energije, izdanu od strane neovisnog tijela za izdavanje jamstva porijekla električne energije, kojom se potvrđuje da je količina - postotni udio električne energije naveden u ponudi odabranog ponuditelja, isporučene električne energije proizvedeno iz obnovljivih izvora energije.Predmetni certifikat odabrani ponuditelj (Opskrbljivač) dužan je predati Naručitelju sukladno Metodologiji utvrđivanja podrijetla električne energije (NN 133/14, 127/19) članak 19. U slučaju nedostavljanja tražene potvrde, odnosno u slučaju da dostavljenom potvrdom odabrani ponuditelj (Opskrbljivač) ne dokaže da je postotni udio, naveden u ponudi odabranog ponuditelja, isporučene električne energije proizveden iz obnovljivih izvora energije, navedeno postupanje smatrat će se povredom ugovornih obveza, temeljem čega Naručitelj zadržava pravo aktiviranja jamstva za uredno ispunjenje ugovora te poduzimanja daljnjih aktivnosti sukladno drugim pozitivnim propisima koji reguliraju predmetno područje. Tijelo nadležno za izdavanje jamstava porijekla električne energije u Republici Hrvatskoj je Hrvatski operator tržišta energije d.o.o. (HROTE).Po isteku ugovora odabrani ponuditelj će dostaviti odgovarajuću potvrdu iz Registra jamstava podrijetla električne energije ili druge dokaze sukladno propisima kojima se uređuje sustav jamstva podrijetla električne energije; kako bi potvrdio koliki je udio električne energije kojom je opskrbljivao naručitelja podrijetlom iz obnovljivih izvora.
